title: One clamp, not three: board.ts, board-detail.ts and manager.ts each hold a copy
notes: Shipped. src/clamp-index.ts holds one clampIndex(value, lastIndex) beside one test, and every list in the app reads it: board.ts, board-detail.ts (both the redraw and the arrow keys), manager.ts, manager-view.ts, picker.ts and board-state.ts. The three copies the issue named plus three more found on the way - picker.ts and board-state.ts were the same shape as the others and now read the same, and the card detail dialog wrote the two halves by hand a hundred lines below the copy it shared. The guards that only fed the old clamp are gone too: lastRow and deleteCard no longer floor a number their callers already floor. The “lists here do not wrap” sentence moved onto move() in manager-view.ts, which decides it. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/19 PR: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/20
